speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are suffering from severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. To help me narrow down the cause of your symptoms, can you tell me exactly where the pain is located and if it radiates to your back or groin?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis (complicated by possible STI). The patient's age, dysuria, vomiting, and specifically the history of pain with sexual intercourse strongly suggest an upper urinary tract infection. I will order a Urinalysis and Urine Culture immediately to confirm the diagnosis and identify any co-infection. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine_Culture.
